name: Align intent
what: Confirm what to build, what observable result means success, and why it matters.
why: A short prompt can hide incompatible assumptions between the user and the agent.
expected_result: The user approves a concise three-part intent contract before decomposition.

implementation.how: Run a read-only discussion gate and store the confirmed answers in an idea node.
implementation.why_this_way: Three high-level questions make disagreement visible without prematurely designing code.

local_findings: Existing AI Dev Companion discussion skills demonstrate the value of a review gate but are not imported.
external_findings: https://openspec.dev/ keeps agreed intent in repository artifacts instead of chat history.
research.reuse_decision: Reuse the durable-spec principle; use a new JSON node contract and no ECL dependency.

weekly_plan.outcome: A user-approved intent node with explicit assumptions and non-goals.

verification.plan: The user can restate what, expected result, and why without discovering an unstated assumption.

future_use: Approved intent becomes the parent contract for all later idea nodes.
outputs: Approved what, expected result, and why
